creator: Codex per Alessio
purpose: Persistent local ESAE development and verification
deletion_condition: Explicit owner authorization; never an automatic sweep

classes.CANONICAL: Instructions, policy and provenance; explicit retirement only
classes.PROJECT: Sources, toolchain, pinned dependencies and distribution archives; explicit retirement only
classes.EVIDENCE: Scan snapshots, database, original tool logs, test results and reports; explicit retirement only
classes.SESSION: Owned server process metadata; stop only the recorded matching process when no scan is active
classes.EPHEMERAL: Only owned unused files created in TMPDIR; remove at the end of their operation

public_reports: Only reports from the owned demo; relative paths, no host paths, no private repository content
